title: ESA BIC Barcelona — space startup incubation, 2026 application round
funder: ESA BIC Barcelona / local programme operator
description: Do not miss our DEMO DAY! (14th July at 9:30 in PMT RDIT Building)Sign in here! IMAGINE BOOSTING YOUR BUSINESS BEYOND THE STARS New deadline for submitting proposals: 13th november 2026 (23:59 CET) We are the European Space Agency Business Incubation Center in Barcelona We aim to support aspiring innovative start-ups. We seek entrepreneurs who: Develop applications leveraging space-based systems, such as satellite navigation, Earth observation, or satellite communication. Apply space technologies in non-space domains, driving cross-industry innovation. Create innovative products and services for the space sector, contributing to its growth and advancement. We Offer 60,000 EUR funding(non – equity) Technical support Business coaching and advise Legal and IPR support Office facilities Use of ESA BIC brand Innovation ecosystemconnection ESA BIC community To apply for the ESA BIC Barcelonayou must have an innovative idea witha strong space connection. Apply Apply Contact us RDIT BuildingCampus del Baix Llobregat.C/ Esteve Terradas 1008860 Castelldefels (Barcelona) Name Email Subject Message (opcional) Accept terms of use and privacy Cristina Protasio Esparó ESA BIC Barcelona Manager Tel: +34 687 19 16 56 cristina.protasio@pmt.es
